observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black console with a black stripe across the top, placed on a wooden surface. The console has a curved edge and a small logo on the top right. The background is a plain wall with visible cables.

Photo 1 shows the same console in front of a TV displaying a football game. The console is on a wooden cabinet with a clock and a black device to the right. The console's design matches the PlayStation 5, with the same white and black color scheme and curved edge.
The console appears to be in a used condition with some dust and minor wear. No visible damage to the casing or ports.
The seller claims it is 'Barely Used' and 'Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.'
No power cord, controller, or other accessories are visible in either photo.

claims.evidence: Photos show minor dust and wear, but no clear signs of heavy use or damage. No serial number or model label visible to confirm condition.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the boot screen and menu, or a photo of the power indicator light.

risks.risk: Console may have disc drive issues or missing accessories (controller, power cable, etc.)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out, including controller, power cable, and any other peripherals.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the back of the console, or a close-up of the model label.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the boot screen.
Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number and model label.
Photo of all included accessories (controller, power cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
